name: mermaid-viewer
displayName: Mermaid Viewer & Mermaid Preview (MMD Diagram, No Sign-In)
description: Free Mermaid viewer and Mermaid preview for .mmd files and mermaid blocks in Markdown. No sign-in, no AI, works offline. Zoom, pan, SVG and PNG export.

enumDescriptions: Follow VS Code: the dark Mermaid theme in dark editor themes, the default one in light themes.
Mermaid's neutral theme, good for printing.
Mermaid's base theme, the one to change with themeVariables.
mermaidViewer.theme.description: Mermaid theme for new previews. A theme set in the diagram itself (%%{init}%% or front matter) wins. You can change it from the toolbar; that choice is kept for this workspace.

mermaidViewer.background.description: Background of the preview and of exported files. You can change it from the toolbar; that choice is kept for this workspace.

mermaidViewer.customBackground.description: The color used when the background is "custom", as #rrggbb.

enumDescriptions: The mouse wheel zooms at the pointer. Drag to pan.
The mouse wheel pans. Ctrl or Cmd plus the wheel zooms, and so does a trackpad pinch.
mermaidViewer.wheel.description: What the mouse wheel does in the diagram view.

mermaidViewer.updateDelayMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before the preview draws the diagram again.

mermaidViewer.maxTextSize.description: Diagrams with more characters than this are not drawn, and the preview says so. Mermaid's own default is 50,000.

mermaidViewer.maxEdges.description: Diagrams with more links than this are not drawn, and the preview says so. Layout time grows fast with links: about 8 s for 2,000 and about a minute for 5,000 on a recent Mac. Raise mermaidViewer.renderTimeoutSeconds with it. Mermaid's own default is 500.

mermaidViewer.renderTimeoutSeconds.description: A diagram that takes longer than this to draw is stopped, and the preview says so.

mermaidViewer.languageIds.description: Language ids that the preview treats as Mermaid, in addition to .mmd and .mermaid files. Add your own if you map other file types to Mermaid with files.associations.

mermaidViewer.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after you have used Mermaid Viewer on a few days. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

mermaidViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the preview. The change shows in previews you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Mermaid Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Preview Mermaid diagrams beside your text, zoom in, and save them as SVG or PNG. No account and no network.

steps.title: Open the preview
steps.description:
Open a .mmd file, or a Markdown file with a mermaid block, and click the preview icon in the editor title. Cmd+K V (Ctrl+K V) does the same.
[Find a .mmd file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.mmd%22%5D)

steps.title: Zoom and pan
steps.description: Scroll to zoom at the pointer, drag to pan. Fit and 100% are in the toolbar, and the keys 0 and 1 do the same.

steps.title: Save SVG or PNG
steps.description: Export saves SVG or PNG. Pick 1x, 2x or 4x and an optional largest width or height, or copy the PNG to the clipboard.

steps.title: Theme, background and limits
steps.description:
Pick the Mermaid theme, the background and the size limits for big diagrams.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mermaidViewer%22%5D)
